title: Steam Client Adds HDR Streaming On Steam Deck OLED, AV1 Video Streaming
byline: Written by Michael Larabel in Valve on 29 July 2026 at 03:07 PM EDT. 13 Comments
excerpt: Today's Steam client beta update brings some new game streaming enhancements for Linux gamers.
content_html:
Today's Steam client beta update brings some new game streaming enhancements for Linux gamers.

First up, for those using the Steam Deck OLED model, there is now support for high dynamic range (HDR) streaming support baked into this newest Steam client beta.

The second Steam streaming enhancement in today's beta is support for AV1 video streaming on the Steam Deck. This AV1 video streaming works when using the experimental SteamRT3 Steam client. Great for those preferring the modern, open AV1 format in place of proprietary video codecs.

Those are the main highlights while there are also a couple of fixes as noted in the release notes for today's Steam Client beta.

content_html_zh:
今天的 Steam 客户端测试版更新为 Linux 游戏玩家带来了一些新的游戏流增强功能。

首先，对于那些使用 Steam Deck OLED 型号的用户来说，最新的 Steam 客户端测试版现在支持高动态范围 (HDR) 流媒体支持。

今天测试版中的第二个 Steam 流媒体增强功能是支持 Steam Deck 上的 AV1 视频流。 当使用实验性 SteamRT3 Steam 客户端时，该 AV1 视频流可以工作。 非常适合那些喜欢现代开放式 AV1 格式而不是专有视频编解码器的人。

这些是主要亮点，同时也有一些修复，如今天 Steam 客户端测试版的发行说明中所述。
